hit_flash.note: Zelda-style hit flash, done in code: redraw the student sprite with its 3 colors swapped. Cycle normal -> flash_1 -> flash_2 -> normal ... for the 1 second of invincibility.

study_bar_flash.note: While the student is charging, the filled part of the study bar pulses (done in code).

plus_popup.note: RPG-style '+1 / +2 / +3' over the student's head: once per second while charging, showing how much that second added. Use plus_3 for +3, plus_2 for +2, plus_1 for +1.
plus_popup.motion: appear, rise 12 px over 0.6 s with a 2 px bounce at the start, blink for 0.2 s, then gone

chair_bonus.note: Charging is counted in points. 1 point = 5% of the study bar (so +1 per second = the old 5% per second).
chair_bonus.rule: When you sit at a chair, you get that chair's bonus rate for the first 2 seconds, then +1 per second. The bonus only comes back when you sit at a DIFFERENT table than the one you last got a bonus from. Moving to another chair at the same table gives +1 only.

noise_bubbles.note: Noise bubbles pop out of the top of the Noise Tornado.
noise_bubbles.motion: float up 8 px over 0.6 s, blink twice, disappear. Pick a random bubble each time.
